[LGRA.6.8] **A rule name is unique in its compilation unit.** The compilation
unit is the file being compiled and every library in its import DAG
([LIMP.6.1]). Two rules in one compilation unit must not share a name, compared
as identifiers are compared ([LNAM.2.1.1]), whether both are in one file, one is
in the file and one in a library, or they are in two libraries. The compiler must
refuse such a program with `DS_VALIDATE_DUPLICATE_RULE`, naming both
declarations.

Every library rule compiles into the importer's artefact whatever the import
took ([LIMP.7.5]), and the artefact attaches a rule's metadata to its terminal
by name ([RDSC.8.3]), so each name must pick out exactly one rule.
